description: Ask anything about crypto: real-time crypto insights, token analytics, trend detection and market intelligence.
x_guidance:
Velvet Unicorn AI DeFi API. All 5 endpoints cost $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402. Workflow: POST JSON body → HTTP 402 challenge → sign EIP-3009 → retry with X-PAYMENT header. 

Endpoint usage:
- POST /api/v1/token_402 — body: {"token": "ETH"} — AI token analysis
- POST /api/v1/wallet_402 — body: {"wallet": "0x..address.."} — AI wallet portfolio analysis
- POST /api/v1/trending_402 — body: {"instruction": "Show me trending tokens on Base"} (instruction optional) — trending tokens
- POST /api/v1/swap_402 — body: {"instruction": "Swap 10 USDC to ETH from wallet 0x..."} — DeFi swap route + tx data
- POST /api/v1/ask_402 — body: {"question": "What are best yields on Base?"} — crypto Q&A

All bodies are JSON. Always include Content-Type: application/json header.
